upstream_source_promotion.directive: SOURCE_PROMOTION_ONLY — NO CLAIMS FORENSICS SEMANTIC MUTATION

rules_applied: Source promotion establishes canonical provenance, not truth or claimant knowledge.
Preserve the Sep. 20 Claims Forensics disposition unless exact promoted wording materially changes the asserted proposition.
Absence of independent corroboration does not automatically establish falsity.
Prospective projections are not adjudicated as present-tense factual falsehoods.
Exact quantitative claims retain their affirmative evidentiary burden, but undefined time windows or measurement denominators are not silently invented.
Control cases remain outside the ordinary accusation-chain denominator.

targets.exact_source_wording: Iran has exported zero barrels thanks to our ironclad blockade.
targets.prior_source_blocker: The Anadolu claim-origin URL was present in the accepted locker but lacked a promoted canonical source object.
targets.denominator_impact: CONTROL_CASE_ONLY; no accusation-chain or unique-proposition denominator increase.
targets.reason: The exact zero-export proposition remains unresolved. The promoted source preserves blockade-period context but does not define a precise start/end window or narrow the measurement denominator to loadings, Hormuz departures, sanctioned exports, observed tanker movements, customs-cleared trade, or another category. Claims Forensics therefore preserves the exact wording and ambiguity rather than manufacturing a more testable proposition.
